_comment: Assets carried over from the v0.1.4 oracle, split by whether v0.2 still ships them byte-identically.
The theme round deliberately changed three page assets and added the site's living-background
renderer, so the old 'every asset matches the oracle' claim is no longer true and must not be
asserted. What remains true is recorded under `unchanged` and still checked digest-for-digest;
each divergence carries the reason it happened, so the difference is evidence rather than drift.

app.js.reason: Every action gated on window.confirm silently did nothing: WKWebView implements no JavaScript dialogs, so confirm() returns false without drawing. That killed create-with-relay, start-public-relay, use-my-own-address, revoke-member and withdraw-standing-consent, leaving the two-Mac join path unreachable with no error. Those five sites now await an in-page <dialog id="ask-dialog">. Disclosure trigger buttons toggle their own <details> panel and keep aria-expanded in step. A claimed pairing card now scrolls into view and focuses its Approve button once: below the fold the action was unreachable without scrolling and returned -25202 to assistive presses, so owners could mint code after code without ever approving one. A failed join now names its real code and a next action beside the field instead of leaving the stale 'membership lapsed' line as the only explanation.

index.html.reason: Adopts the site's dark Green token set and the background renderer's layout rules; the header mark is 56px with the wordmark block vertically centred, disclosures are real text buttons, and (v0.2 copy) the hero no longer claims the device has 'earned' anything at onboarding: it now reads 'add your first device, and see exactly what it shares—and what stays yours', which drops the single-platform wording for a product that will run on other devices too.

style.css.reason: Adopts the site's dark Green token set (ground #010301, ink #e7f2e3, accent #58f56a, art tokens --strand/--glow/--core), Fraunces for h1-h3 via the embedded woff2, and the layout rules the background renderer needs (.page-mycelium, .page-mycelium-field, .mycelium-breath, .hero-art). The header mark is 56px with the wordmark block vertically centred against it, and disclosure buttons are styled as plain text inside the summary.

mycelium-field.js.reason: Was carried verbatim from mycelium_swarm_directory/web. The life layer's 128 px tiles left whole colonies clipped as squares: a tile first painted while its neighbourhood was empty kept `cands = false` for good, so strands that grew into it later were never drawn there and terminated on the tile edge. Candidates are now recomputed until a tile has held a strand and boxes are tested with a 2 px bleed, the hero's page-anchored composite fades in over its own first 200 px (the raster is a rectangle, so it read as a knife-cut under the header), and the life tiles fade their part of that same band.

chat.js.reason: Lane CAP (owner ruling 15 Nov): the stage capacity is the model's 4,096-token serving context, and a prompt the page accepts (2,000 characters) can be up to 8,000 tokens with the byte-level tokenizer, so the route can refuse it (joined_route_context_exceeds_worker). The chat service names that refusal chat_context_too_long; this script gains its message and appends the context from the chat state's limits.context_tokens instead of showing the route's internal code. The page's own limits are unchanged.

mycelium-boot.js.source: app-local: boots createHero/createField, dark Green only (no hue or theme switch)

mark.svg.reason: mycelium colony mark (W2) replacing the inherited asterisk glyph; drawn for both the site and the app

icon.source: authored: W2 colony mark (icons/icon.png regenerated from the chosen mark)
icon.reason: macOS icons carry their own squircle mask; the tile was square and read as a foreign shape in the Dock.
